descriptions.zh:
对象存储OSS支持WORM（Write Once Read Many）特性，允许以不可删除、不可篡改的方式保存和使用数据。OSS允许针对存储空间（Bucket）设置基于时间的合规保留策略，保护周期为1天到70年。

- 当基于时间的合规保留策略创建24小时后未提交锁定，则该策略自动失效。当合规保留策略锁定后，您可以在Bucket中上传和读取文件（Object），但是在Object的保留时间到期之前，不允许删除Object及合规保留策略。Object的保留时间到期后，才可以删除Object。关于合规保留策略的更多信息，请参见[合规保留策略](~~90564~~)。

- 同一个Bucket中，版本控制和合规保留策略无法同时配置。如果Bucket已开启版本控制功能，则无法再配置保留策略。关于版本控制功能更多信息，请参见[版本控制介绍](~~109685~~)。
descriptions.en:
Object Storage Service (OSS) supports the Write Once Read Many (WORM) feature, which allows you to store and use data in a non-deletable and non-modifiable manner. OSS allows you to configure a time-data retention policy for a bucket with a protection period ranging from 1 day to 70 years.

- If a time-data retention policy is not locked within 24 hours after it is created, the policy automatically expires. After a retention policy is locked, you can upload and read objects in the bucket. However, you cannot delete objects or the retention policy before the retention period of the objects expires. You can delete objects only after their retention periods expire. For more information about retention policies, see [Retention policy](~~90564~~).

- Versioning and retention policies cannot be configured at the same time for the same bucket. If versioning is enabled for a bucket, you cannot configure a retention policy for the bucket. For more information about versioning, see [Overview of versioning](~~109685~~).
